title: Manhunt on for suspect in Bukidnon town slay attempt

blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — A 39-year-old utility driver survived a brazen daylight ambush while his passenger suffered injuries after a motorcycle-riding gunman opened fire along a village road in Barangay North Poblacion, Maramag, Bukidnon on Friday afternoon, November 13. Police have since put up a containment ring as part of a manhunt against the still unidentified suspect. Police identified the primary target of the ambush only as “Tonton,” of Purok 5, Barangay South Poblacion in Maramag. His 55-year-old female passenger, a resident of Purok 5B, Zubiri Village in North Poblacion, was also hurt during the attack. READ: Police official survives NPA […]...
